description: "Completely rebuilt the Old KOT dialog to match the web app's feature-rich modal. Added: table-style layout with Item Name/Qty/Amount/Actions columns, qty +/- controls per item, checkbox selection per item, reason text input for cancellation, Select All toggle, Complementary/Delete KOT/Cancel KOT action buttons in footer, and cancelled/complementary item visual states. This replaces the previous simple list+close button dialog."
instruction: "Replace the entire Old KOT dialog with a feature-rich version matching the web app's Old KOT modal. Add: header with title and close button, toolbar with Select All checkbox, table with Item Name, Qty (+/- buttons), Amount, Actions (checkbox + reason input), footer with Complementary, Delete KOT, Cancel KOT buttons and OK button. Track selected items and reasons with local mutableStateMapOf."
